_run: Third dataset. PXD032202, 'Global and comparative proteome signatures in the lens capsule, trabecular meshwork, and iris of patients with pseudoexfoliation glaucoma' (Sahay, Chakraborty & Rao, Front Mol Biosci 2022, PMID 35517867): 21 raw, 14.3 GB, Q Exactive, Top10 HCD, label-free DDA, WHOLE TISSUE and unfractionated. Chosen to complement PXD036557 and PXD027318, which are both cell culture: this is PRIMARY HUMAN TISSUE and it carries THREE tissues (lens capsule, trabecular meshwork, iris) in one deposit, which is the first thing in the instance that can speak to Q-P3 (do organs age along different trajectories). Pseudoexfoliation glaucoma is strongly age-related and the lens capsule is a basement membrane, where matrix ageing shows. Groups are PARTLY readable from the file names and the naming is inconsistent: CONT1-3 and CONTROL_1-3 are both controls, PXG1-3 and PXG_1-3 are both glaucoma, PXF_1-3 is pseudoexfoliation without glaucoma. Worse, THE TISSUE IS NOT IN THE FILE NAME - it is implied only by the Sample_NN ranges (43-48, 49-54, 55-57, 88-93), which is four blocks for three tissues. So the tissue assignment cannot be recovered from the deposit alone and must not be guessed; the run is searched as one dataset and the tissue axis is recorded as unavailable. NOTE: donor ages are NOT stated in the deposit or the paper, so this still does not give the instance an age axis.
